goal: Ensure CI workflow tokens are restricted to read-only permissions across contributor forks
Prevent CI jobs from executing with unnecessary write privileges when fork defaults are permissive
reviewability: Nothing is known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Strong support for hardening CI by applying least privilege explicitly to forks (real-or-random)
Suggestions to slim down workflow configuration and update PR details were addressed (maflcko)

categories.name: tests
why: P4 because it is a minor defense-in-depth hardening measure rather than an improvement to testing
Upstream repository defaults are already read-only, so the benefit primarily aids contributor forks
It does not alter test coverage, execution signals, or test framework capabilities
